sql:
SELECT
    g.RegionCountryName AS country,
    avg(customer_purchase_span_days) AS avg_days_between_first_and_most_recent_purchase
FROM
(
    SELECT
        c.CustomerKey,
        g.RegionCountryName,
        dateDiff('day', min(os.DateKey), max(os.DateKey)) AS customer_purchase_span_days
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS os
    INNER JOIN retail.DimCustomer AS c
        ON os.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimGeography AS g
        ON c.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey
    GROUP BY
        c.CustomerKey,
        g.RegionCountryName
) AS customer_spans
GROUP BY country
ORDER BY country
